card.name: Punctuation before HIV protease inhibitor names
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (commas, 'including', 'except', closing parentheses) right before a list of HIV protease inhibitor drug names such as ritonavir, indinavir or atazanavir. It also fires on a few unrelated link words in web text, like 'such as'.

modes.label: Drug-list connectors
modes.description: A comma, 'including', 'except' or a closing parenthesis just before the next HIV drug name in an interaction list.
modes.example: combinations of HIV protease inhibitors,<< including>> saquinavir plus ritonav

modes.label: Link words in web text
modes.description: 'such as' or 'so-called' introducing an example or term in general prose.
modes.example: of natural disturbances such<< as>> wildfire, which limits forest intrusion into the

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed fragments with no clear link, so the output effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the gap just before the next HIV drug name in a list of drug interactions.
